title: EvidenT: Building Trustworthy Enterprise Assistants through Evidence Groundedness and Traceability
abstract: arXiv:2609.22537v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise AI assistants must produce responses that are verifiable and traceable to source evidence. However, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) over heterogeneous enterprise data can suffer from citation drift, unsupported content, and weak source traceability. We present EvidenT (T = Trust + Transparency + Traceability), a lightweight pipeline that verifies extracted evidence against retrieved documents before answer generation, without model retraining. EvidenT combines structured passage extraction with deterministic lexical alignment to filter unsupported content, correct citation drift, and preserve source-span traceability. On approximately 500 real enterprise queries, EvidenT improves gold-source hit rate by an average of 29% over prompting baselines, produces no citations to nonretrieved urls, and achieves near-saturated answer-to-source lexical coverage.

translated_title: EvidenT：通过证据落地性与可追溯性构建可信的企业智能助手
translated_abstract: 企业AI助手必须生成可验证且可追溯到源证据的回答。然而，在异构企业数据上进行检索增强生成（RAG）时，可能出现引用漂移、无依据内容以及源可追溯性弱等问题。我们提出了EvidenT（T = Trust + Transparency + Traceability，即信任+透明度+可追溯性），这是一个轻量级流水线，在生成答案之前根据检索到的文档对所提取的证据进行验证，且无需重新训练模型。EvidenT将结构化段落提取与确定性词汇对齐相结合，以过滤无依据内容、纠正引用漂移并保留源文本跨度的可追溯性。在约500个真实企业查询上，EvidenT相比提示基线平均将黄金源命中率提高了29%，未产生任何指向未检索URL的引用，并实现了接近饱和的答案到源的词汇覆盖率。
tldr: EvidenT提出了一种无需模型重训练的轻量级验证流水线，通过结构化段落提取与确定性词汇对齐在答案生成前校验证据，显著提升了企业RAG助手的引用准确性与源可追溯性。
en_tdlr: EvidenT introduces a lightweight, retraining-free pipeline that verifies extracted evidence against retrieved documents before answer generation, improving citation accuracy and source traceability for enterprise RAG assistants with an average 29% gain in gold-source hit rate.
